title: Genevieve Heydt
text:
This is a digital portfolio and resume site created by me, Genevieve Heydt.
I graduated with a BS in Actuarial Mathematics with minors in Computer Science and Economics from the University of Michigan - Flint in 2022. I am currently studying for an MS in Insurance Management with a concentraion in Applied Business Analytics from Boston University. I currently work as a Project Lead for a Data Engineering team at Auto-Owners Insurance in Michigan.
